candidates.title: Alibaba Cloud Unveils Agent-Native Innovations at WAIC
candidates.summary: Official Alibaba Group announcement from WAIC 2026 covering the agent-native cloud suite (AgentRun, AgentLoop, AgentTeams), TokenWorks PaaS inference platform, and the full-stack AI infrastructure refresh within which Alibaba Cloud introduced TPN at the network layer.

candidates.title: Beyond Prefill-Decode Disaggregation: Dissecting LLM Inference for Heterogeneous Platforms via Dynamic Operator Scheduling
candidates.summary: 该论文指出异构平台上的传统 Prefill/Decode 解耦不足以处理设备争用和工作负载变化，提出阶段感知 DAG、动态算子到设备放置及权重布局仲裁，以协调不同阶段的计算与通信；在 NPU/PIM 系统上相对 PD 基线获得 1.20–2.23 倍几何平均加速。

candidates.title: Topology-Aware Data Movement for Disaggregated GPU Inference
candidates.summary: Argues that uniform RDMA for inter-pool KV cache transfer ignores 72x bandwidth variation across GPU pairs, and proposes a topology-aware orchestrator selecting among NVLink, PCIe, RDMA, and CXL transports, reporting 3-18x transfer latency reduction over uniform RDMA.
